patch_description: This program is a crossover that blends the strongest motifs from the prior candidates while keeping parameter efficiency high (matching the 78-parameter best). The evolved ANSATZ_SPEC (inside EVOLVE-BLOCK) uses symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations (shared params for corners/edges/center), a parametrized CRZ ring backbone plus separate center-edge CRZs, targeted three-qubit ZZZ motifs aligned with the eight winning lines (shared by orientation), and doubly-controlled CCRZ interactions focused on center-related triples. A single shared post-RZ parameter is used to keep parameter count low and encourage useful global phase flexibility. The resulting per-block unique parameter count is 13 -> 13 * N_UPLOADS(3) * N_REPEATS(2) = 78 total parameters (matching the best-performing variant), while preserving useful geometric motifs (winning-line triples, center-conditioned CCRZs, ring entanglement). No changes were made outside the EVOLVE block to ensure identical inputs/outputs and to maintain the fixed training/evaluation protocol.
